jobs.title: Lead Data Scientist – Virtual Models
jobs.excerpt: We are looking for a Lead Data Scientist – Virtual Models to take ownership of this programme from the start.
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Lead Data Scientist – Virtual Models to take ownership of this programme from the start.

This is a hands-on role for an experienced data scientist who wants to build something new. You will assess existing datasets across QIMA’s Business Units, identify the most promising opportunities, develop proof-of-concept models and prepare them for use by internal teams and, ultimately, by clients.

Initial applications may include models related to:

  • skin;
  • hair follicles;
  • longevity;
  • prostate cancer;
  • immunology.

You will work closely with Managing Directors, laboratory scientists and QIMA’s IT and AI experts. Scientific validation will be carried out in collaboration with independent laboratory teams.

Key responsibilities

  • Review and assess proposals from QIMA’s Business Units.
  • Examine the underlying data in detail, including its quality, structure, consistency, depth and breadth.
  • Recommend one or two models with the strongest potential for development, subject to approval by the CEO of QIMA Life Sciences.
  • Build and manage the required data pipelines.
  • Clean, structure, integrate and analyse complex biological datasets.
  • Develop machine learning models and proof of concepts.
  • Identify data gaps and recommend additional experiments where needed. Work with laboratory scientists to help define these experiments, including the required data, measurements and quality criteria.
  • Establish clear validation criteria and prepare models for independent scientific validation.
  • Improve the models through repeated testing and iteration.
  • Ensure that code, data and models are reproducible, traceable and properly documented.
  • Present results clearly to scientific, technical, commercial and non-specialist audiences.
  • Support the preparation of a model for future commercialisation, either as a SaaS product or as a service supporting, replacing or complementing wet-lab assays.
  • Contribute to the documentation and protection of intellectual property related to the models, pipelines and methods.

This role will initially be an individual contributor position. As the programme grows, you may help build and lead a team of additional data scientists.

First objectives

Within the first six months, you will be expected to:

  • assess the main model proposals and their underlying datasets;
  • recommend the one or two strongest projects;
  • establish a proof of concept for one or two models.

Within 12 to 15 months, the objective will be to prepare at least one model for potential commercialisation. This should include sufficient scientific validation, an interface usable internally, and complete documentation or detailed operator training.

You have:

  • a PhD in data science, biostatistics, bioinformatics, machine learning or a related field;
  • 8–10 years of experience in data science, biostatistics and machine learning;
  • a proven track record of delivering complex machine learning projects using complex biological datasets;
  • strong experience building data pipelines, assessing data quality, identifying limitations and defining what additional data is needed;
  • experience working with scientists and translating scientific questions into data and modelling approaches;
  • excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to non-specialists;
  • ideally, experience presenting work to clients, partners or other external stakeholders;
  • a practical, entrepreneurial and hands-on approach;
  • the ability to work independently and take ownership of an ambiguous, new project.

Experience in a specific therapeutic area is not essential. The most important requirements are strong technical expertise, experience with biological data and the ability to turn complex datasets into useful, validated models.

Strong Python or R skills, including production-quality, version-controlled code. Experience with cloud data platforms (we use Snowflake) and MLOps practices.

Why join QIMA?

This is an opportunity to build a new capability from the ground up and shape how QIMA uses its biological data. You will have direct access to senior leadership, laboratory experts and technical teams, with the autonomy to define the approach and deliver tangible results.

The role will be based in Europe and will require travel, depending on project needs, to QIMA laboratories in France, Northern Ireland and Germany.

Does this describe you? Then we want to hear from you as soon as possible! Apply now with your CV in Englishand we can write the next chapter of the QIMA story together!

At QIMA, we are on a mission to help our clients make products consumers can trust. We have developed compliance solutions for testing, inspection and certification (TIC) that enable supply chain agility, sustainability and product innovation. Our services are used by 30,000 businesses globally in the consumer products, agri-food and life sciences industries. Backed by 6,000+ dedicated Qimates worldwide, we bring local expertise and tailored support to every client. Our passion for service has made QIMA an industry leader for customer satisfaction, as highlighted by our exceptional Net Promoter Score (NPS).

Through our Life Sciences activities, we develop and deliver scientific testing and research services for our clients.

We are now launching a new programme to develop virtual pharmacology models. These models will use the data generated through years of laboratory work to help assess the efficacy of molecules and support future screening activities.

jobs.description:
Data Scientist (Senior Staff, Staff, & Senior roles available)

About the company

In the coming decades, demand for critical minerals such as copper, lithium, and cobalt will continue to grow. These minerals are needed to build electric infrastructure, vehicles, data centers, and electronics. However, the mining industry is making 10x fewer discoveries per dollar spent on exploration compared to 30 years ago because the easy-to-find, near surface deposits have largely been discovered.

KoBold was founded to be the first AI native mineral exploration, mine development, and technology development company. Our goal is to turn mineral exploration into a repeatable science to discover the minerals the world needs—by integrating artificial intelligence, human intelligence, and new technology. Our multidisciplinary teams of data scientists, engineers, and geologists work together to build data systems, design new sensors, and establish industry-leading workflows to develop and test subsurface predictions on our exploration projects.

Our first discovery, Mingomba, is a high-grade copper deposit in Zambia, found after spending materially less than industry average. We are developing Mingomba with the same technical rigor that we apply to exploration. The Mingomba team brings together mine and processing engineers, geologists, data scientists, software engineers, and community, health & safety, construction, and operations specialists. By combining industry knowledge and cutting edge technology, we are developing Mingomba into a world class project that has safer and more predictable outcomes for ourselves, partners, and communities. It is expected to create thousands of good jobs for generations.

KoBold runs exploration programs in eight countries, all with the potential for another discovery.

KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and strategic natural resources companies BHP and Mitsubishi.

We are hiring a Data Scientists to help accelerate our mission.

About the position

In this role, you will build predictive models and apply a wide range of scientific computing, statistical, and physics-based methods to find places where there is evidence of ore-forming processes at work and to predict the locations of ore-grade mineralization in 2D and 3D. You will help build a worldwide dataset that underlies our exploration program, with careful attention to identifying and quantifying uncertainty in the data and in our predictions. You will create models and develop software to accelerate discovery of critical battery metals.

You will join an outstanding team of data scientists and engineers and will work closely with KoBold’s world-renowned geoscientists to incorporate our best understanding of the chemical and physical processes that create ore deposits. Working with your geoscience colleagues, you will create 2D and 3D geologic predictions, identify exploration targets, design field programs to collect data, and use that data to reduce the uncertainty in our predictions and guide the next phase of field work.

Ultimately, your role is to help KoBold make valuable discoveries by building data tools to solve scientific problems. As one of the early members of this team, you will help build these tools from the ground up.

Responsibilities

The Data Scientist will:

  • Help develop KoBold’s proprietary software exploration tools.
  • Find and curate geophysical, geochemical, geologic, and geographic data and integrate it into KoBold’s proprietary data system.
  • Build models to make statistically valid predictions about the locations of compositional anomalies within the Earth’s crust.
  • Create effective visualizations for evaluating model performance and enabling rapid interaction with the underlying data and key features.
  • Develop and apply data processing, statistical, and physics-based techniques to geoscientific data — from computer vision to geophysical inversions — and use the results to guide our targeting efforts and inform our acquisition and exploration decisions.
  • Present to and collaborate with our external partners and stakeholders.

Qualifications

A great Data Scientist candidate will have:

Technical skills, including extensive experience with:

  • Python’s data science packages and general software engineering practices.
  • Collaborative software development (git), and familiarity with software engineering best practices like unit test / integration test suites, and CICD pipelines.
  • Cloud computing resources.
  • Building predictive models, applying them to different problems, and evaluating and interpreting the results.
  • Data from a variety of physical systems.
  • Geospatial analyses and visualizations.

Technical knowledge:

  • Broad skills in and knowledge of applied statistics and Bayesian inference
  • Substantial understanding of machine learning algorithms

Training and work experience:

  • An advanced degree in the physical sciences, engineering, computer science, or mathematics.
  • A minimum work experience of 4 years post PhD or 8 years post MS, ideally as a data scientist or data engineer.
  • Experience leading technical teams to apply novel scientific approaches to core business problems

Work practices and motivation:

  • Ability to take ownership and responsibility of large projects.
  • Ability to explain technical problems to and collaborate on solutions with domain experts.
  • Communicates well on a collaborative, cross-functional team.
  • Excitement about joining a fast-growing early-stage company, comfort with a dynamic work environment, and eagerness to take on a range of responsibilities.
  • Ability to independently prioritize multiple tasks effectively.
  • Intellectual curiosity and eagerness to learn about all aspects of mineral exploration, particularly in the geology domain.
  • Enjoys constantly learning such that you are driving insights through using our tools in exploration and willing to work directly with geologists in the field.
  • Keen not just to build cool technology, but to figure out what technical product to build to best achieve the business objectives of the company.
  • A valid passport and willingness to travel to observe our work at Mingomba or at an exploration site around the world.

It is also helpful but not required to have experience with:

  • Creating machine learning models on geospatial data
  • Geostatistics
  • Image processing or computer vision
  • Distributed computing applications for machine learning and other computations

What to Expect

Joining KoBold means getting the opportunity for hands-on exposure to our exploration projects around the world. All employees are expected to travel to project sites, with a minimum of one week per year. Field-facing and technical roles spend significantly more time in the field.

KoBold Metals is an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity for people of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, age, citizenship, disability, or veteran status.

The US base salary range for this full-time exempt position is $140,000 - $260,000 plus equity and benefits, including 401k match.

Location: KoBold is a remote-first workplace. All candidates must be legally authorized to work in one of the following countries: United States, Canada, Australia, South Africa, United Kingdom, Zambia, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Namibia, Finland, Sweden, or Botswana.

Compensation ranges are listed in USD. If you are based outside the US, the range may not translate directly: US pay reflects a different market with different competitive dynamics, so we benchmark roles against the local market rather than converting the listed figure.

Make interesting images to show audiences both with and without technical understanding complex data insights.

Keeping up with the most recent news in data science, machine learning, and analytics can help you to maintain your methods and approaches current.
